displayIdentity.body: Moses is told to remain before God and teach the people, while capable leaders handle smaller disputes. The burden is redistributed before Sinai’s covenant scene begins.
displayIdentity.title: Leadership becomes distributed

sceneSteps.body: The wilderness has already exposed that Moses cannot carry every responsibility alone; Sinai will intensify his role in a different direction.
